outcome: A poller stops on its own once the thing it is waiting for has happened.

acceptance_criteria.text: Polling stops once the condition holds.

expected_verification.assertion: a poller whose condition becomes true stops calling

acceptance_criteria.text: A poller leaves no timer running once it has stopped, however it stopped.

expected_verification.assertion: no interval remains pending after the poller stops

security_impact: None. A leaked interval is a resource leak.
